# Sell your app with Stripe. Let the license keys take care of themselves.

> Sell desktop apps, plugins and CLI tools with Stripe and issue signed license keys automatically. Generate a key pair, sign a test license and verify it right in your browser, then run the source-available server in your own account. Free, FSL-1.1-MIT, no per-license fee.

Free to use and source available (FSL-1.1-MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
